notes.text:
### Features

More raid/negative filler variety - "raid traps" should now choose any "big threat," so can include things like infestations, mech drops, or animal insanity. Normal negative filler also has a chance for any negative event, including diseases and the like.
Trade locations now have fake logic, so they aren't all in-logic at once.
Quest locations have been added. Like raids and trade locations, completing a quest with an item for a reward will include a quest location item.
Implemented deathlink - If a player on the server dies, it will cause a negative, stacking thought in all colonists. If a colonist dies, it will send a deathlink to the server.

### Bugfixes

Changed raid/trade locations so they can't be savescummed.
Items sent as filler will now be sent in increments of ~200 silver, rather than (roughly) "1 full stack"
Changed drop pod behavior to use the trading drop pod logic, so they drop closer to your base
Location items can be stockpiled
Blood Rain research should now grant correctly when sent from AP
Fixed a bug where logic for raid/trade locations wasn't applying properly
